tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List the applications this API key can access, with the caller role and the permissions it grants. Start here when using a personal API key (usr_...): every other tool needs an explicit applicationId, which this tool supplies.

tools.name: create_application
tools.description: Create a new application (workspace) owned by the caller. Requires a personal API key (usr_...) — application-scoped keys cannot create applications. Seeds default flows unless skipDefaultFlows is true.

tools.name: update_application
tools.description: Update application-level settings (name, active state, default language, incoming-message behavior). Requires the manage_settings permission in that application.

tools.name: get_workspace_summary
tools.description: Return compact application, flow, and bot summary without variables or full graph details.

tools.name: get_variable_context
tools.description: Search variables by scope/query. Values are omitted unless includeValues is true.

tools.name: get_application_context
tools.description: Return application-level automation context: flows, bots, and variables.

tools.name: get_module_catalog
tools.description: Return a compact installed and marketplace module index with names, descriptions, actions, and triggers.

tools.name: get_module_details
tools.description: Return full details for one selected module, including action input fields, trigger config, manual setup fields, and installed action references.

tools.name: install_module
tools.description: Install an exact marketplace module version into an application and create any missing installed-template actions. Requires the manage_automation permission. Call get_module_catalog first to select the module and version, then get_module_details after installation to inspect setup requirements and i

tools.name: get_flow_context
tools.description: Return compact flow graph topology and block summaries without full block data or action configs.

tools.name: get_block_details
tools.description: Return full details for one selected block, including block data, action configs, HTTP bodies, custom code files, triggers, menu payloads, and media paths.

tools.name: get_action_schema
tools.description: Return supported action kinds and important invariants for draft/apply flow edits.

tools.name: get_design_guidelines
tools.description: Return shared flow-design guidance and examples used by both AI prompt assembly and MCP consumers.

tools.name: search_flow_examples
tools.description: Search compact reusable flow examples by keyword or tag for common business cases.

tools.name: get_flow_example
tools.description: Return one reusable flow example by id, optionally including its full action-batch schema example.

tools.name: validate_actions
tools.description: Dry-run validation of a proposed batch of flow-builder actions without mutating state. OPTIONAL: apply_actions runs this same validation itself and applies nothing when invalid, so calling validate_actions first is redundant — use it only to check a draft you do not intend to apply yet.

tools.name: apply_actions
tools.description: Validate and apply a batch of flow-builder actions. Validation always runs first; when it fails, nothing is applied and the same errors validate_actions would return are reported. Call this directly — a separate validate_actions call beforehand is unnecessary.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a plain-text message to ONE contact right now, outside any flow. For reaching many contacts use a broadcast instead. tools.name: list_broadcasts
tools.description: List broadcasts in the application, with status, schedule, and delivery counts. Supports filtering by status/bot/recurrence and pagination.

tools.name: get_broadcast_details
tools.description: Return full details for a single broadcast: status, schedule, recurrence, linked flow, and delivery breakdown by status.

tools.name: get_broadcast_analytics
tools.description: Return analytics/stats for a broadcast: delivery breakdown by status plus per-message-block sent/clicked stats for its flow over an optional date window.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_broadcast_analytics · Private data: list_applications, create_application, get_block_details, send_message · Public sink: send_message, get_broadcast_details, get_broadcast_analytics · Destructive: validate_actions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_broadcast_analytics · Private data: list_applications, create_application, get_block_details, send_message · Public sink: send_message, get_broadcast_details, get_broadcast_analytics · Destructive: validate_actions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

labels.name: list_broadcasts
labels.description: List broadcasts in the application with status, schedule, and delivery counts. Read-only. Filters combine as AND. Note that delivery counts report messages attempted, not confirmed deliveries. Use get_broadcast_details for one broadcast's full breakdown.

labels.name: get_broadcast_details
labels.description: Return full details for a single broadcast: status, schedule, recurrence rule, linked flow, and delivery breakdown by status. Read-only. Call list_broadcasts first to find the broadcastId. For per-message-block engagement stats use get_broadcast_analytics instead.

labels.name: get_broadcast_analytics
labels.description: Return engagement analytics for a broadcast: delivery breakdown by status plus per-message-block sent and clicked counts for its flow, over an optional date window. Read-only. Sent counts reflect messages attempted, not confirmed deliveries.
